translations.en:
A vampire subspecies said to
suffocate sleeping humans, tear
out their hearts, and drink
blood directly from them.
Despite these cruel acts, she
looks like a sweet young girl,
making the contrast all the
more terrifying. An undead
creature utterly devoid of
emotion, she is likely a more
difficult opponent than a
vampire that still has feelings.

translations.en:
This monster's true body cannot
escape the sealed Prison of the
Old Ones, so it will never be
encountered in this world. However,
it can apparently project its
spirit here. It interferes with
humanity in a grotesque fashion,
collecting human corpses and
arranging them into the shape of
its own face. Even if the piled-up
bodies are blown apart, its
lack of a physical form prevents
its destruction. A country
where it appears will become
a land of the dead overnight.

translations.en:
The queen who reigns at the
pinnacle of vampirekind. Few
adventurers can resist her
beckoning; far more willingly
offer her their throats. Even
a warrior strong enough to
resist will find their
attacks evaded at blinding
speed, then face strength
so monstrous that one blow
from her slender arm can leave
their armor half destroyed.
translations.note: Meaning review: the source says half-destroyed armor, not nearly complete destruction.

translations.en:
Reigning above all vampires,
he is feared as the king
of the undead inhabiting
this world. He commands
every undead monster and
is said to be impossible
to kill by any means. He
does not seek prosperity
for vampirekind, preferring
instead to spend
eternity watching the
world sink into decay.

translations.en:
The ghost of a high-ranking cleric
who opposed the pontiff of the
Quopati Legal Academy and sought
to seize his authority and
control. Various spirits, drawn
to that greed, now bind his soul,
making him something akin to a
collective of the dead. Formerly
a high-ranking Bishop, he
wields every kind of magic. As
a ghost, he is also highly
resistant to death and spells.

translations.en:
With green skin, exposed red
muscle, and an enormous scythe,
it severs human heads and
harvests souls. It sometimes
breathes poisonous mist potent
enough to dissolve human skin.
Its true nature is unknown,
but it returns to life
repeatedly. This repeated
resurrection is why it is
classified as an undead monster.

translations.en:
Among a cult that sought
eternal life, a
high-ranking mage named
Lee-Yi discovered a
method of turning himself
into an undead being.

Retaining the awareness he
had as a human, he attacks
people with overwhelming
power, wielding an immortal
body and formidable spells.

translations.en:
An ogre is a male,
demon-like giant. Violent
and cruel, it eats raw
human flesh. It possesses
almost no intelligence
or wisdom, so humans do
not find it particularly
difficult to defeat.

It has also lost the regenerative ability
characteristic of giants. Even so, a
moment's carelessness may allow it to
crush your head with a single blow.

translations.en:
A giant strongly influenced
by the element of earth. By
nature, these beings are
not hostile to humans;
indeed, they are rather
gentle. However... perhaps
poisoned by the labyrinth's
magical essence, they now
attack indiscriminately more
often than not. Their skin
is solid rock, and an
ordinary adventurer cannot
leave even a scratch on it.

translations.en:
A giant strongly influenced by
the element of wind. It uses
blasts of air to slice through
adventurers and blow them away.

Defeating a being clad in
armor of wind is no easy feat.
It will prove a formidable
opponent even among giants.

translations.en:
A giant strongly influenced
by the element of fire.
Extremely warlike, these giants
are covered in flames hot
enough to melt rock. One blow
can instantly dissolve armor
and shields. Without magically
enhanced equipment, adventurers
are unlikely to stand
a chance against them.

translations.en:
A giant strongly influenced
by the element of water. Its
breath is cold enough to
freeze the air. If the air
grows strangely chilly deep
in a labyrinth, where
geothermal heat should make
it hot, this signals its
approach. Beware of frostbite
when fighting one, or your
skin may already be dead
by the time you notice.

translations.en:
Giants are beings closer to the
realm of gods than monsters.
The cyclops, however, is more
aptly called the giant closest
to being a monster. It is not
influenced by any element.
Perhaps because its huge body
gives it absolute confidence,
it is exceptionally ferocious.

translations.en:
Originally a giant strongly
imbued with the earth element.
After absorbing excessive toxins
from the earth, however, its
skin, sweat, blood, and saliva...
everything about it became
lethally poisonous to humans.
It is agile for a giant, and
its poisonous breath can supposedly
take even a mighty adventurer's
life in a single blast.

Among the weakest kinds
of lycanthrope, but it
is quick and has sharp
fangs. If bitten, adventurers
must also beware of
the germs it carries.

translations.en:
A wolfman that transforms into a
wolflike shape beneath the full moon...
In labyrinths, the influence of
magical essence apparently lets it
transform without seeing the moon.

It is swift enough to kick off walls
and ceilings and leap through the
air. Combined with its tremendous
strength, this can deal fatal wounds
to adventurers only just growing
accustomed to the labyrinth.

translations.en:
A weretiger is a tiger-man.
Its blows are heavier than
a werewolf's, allowing it to
survive in labyrinths without
joining a pack. Its hooked
claws destroy wooden shields
in a single stroke, while
its tough fur blocks simple
spells. It easily evades
feeble sword attacks.

Sometimes vampires keep them
alongside werewolves and send
them out to hunt humans.

translations.en:
Also called Chimaera,
Kimera, Kaimera,
or Chimere.

Its many names could be seen
as evidence of sightings
around the world. An
artificial creature made by
the Dragoon race in the age
when they ruled the world.
It is hermaphroditic and
reproduces by itself. As
it breeds in summer, chimera
hunts have become a
seasonal summer tradition.

translations.en:
A monster whose existence has
been recorded since the age
of Dragoon civilization.

An artificial life-form with a
woman's upper body and a snake's
lower body. It carries both
paralyzing and ordinary poison.
Once it catches a victim, it
drains every last drop of
blood. Its torso and tail are
covered in silvery-gray scales,
and it can move its snakelike
hair to capture prey.

translations.en:
A black bull with golden
wings, brass claws, and
tusks like a boar's. Said
to be a composite creature
made by the Dragoon race,
it instantly petrifies
anyone caught in its gaze.

Gorgon heads have long
been used to ward off evil.
Even today, rural households
often hang ornaments
shaped like a bull's head
beneath their eaves.

translations.en:
One of the spirits born from the
element that governs flame. It
commands many forms of magic and
possesses powers humans lack,
including shapeshifting. It is
also surprisingly intelligent.

Its mastery over fire is
particularly terrifying. Within
its own barrier, it can produce
temperatures exceeding even
the boiling point of rock.

translations.en:
A mid-ranking elemental. It is
said to be a human soul that,
through some twist of fate, left
the cycle of reincarnation and
became a spirit. It shifts unstably
between this world and another
dimension, making attacks difficult
to land and sometimes nullifying
spells. It attacks with poison
and magic, and possesses a limited
regenerative ability that
instantly restores damaged parts.

translations.en:
A spirit of souls. It harvests
souls and devours them,
denying them reincarnation.
In truth, it is a noble
being that preserves the
world's balance by destroying
the excess souls that
continue to multiply.

For some reason, it is now running
wild. It seeks not only wandering
souls, but also kills the
living to steal their souls.

translations.en:
Known as ghost fire, it is
often thought to be a dead
person's soul, but is actually
a high-ranking elemental.

Almost entirely incorporeal, it
is barely affected by sword
strikes, blows, or spells of any
kind. In return, it strikes with
a flash of light resembling an
electric shock. It is said to
belong to the element of the soul.

translations.en:
A spirit of wind. Famous as a
spirit of the lamp, its
supernatural power creates
miracles great enough to threaten
the very laws of this world.

Ordinarily it works to
preserve the world's balance.
Without a master, however,
it seems to have run wild,
attacking adventurers and
travelers as it pleases.

translations.en:
A kind of fire elemental with
the shape of a dinosaur.

Unlike ifrits and other humanoid
elementals that show signs of
intelligence, it has no human
form and cannot be communicated
with. It has greater fighting
power than an ifrit and
remains true to the essential
nature of an elemental.

translations.en:
In ancient religions, wolves
were revered as mountain gods.
The largest were supposedly
able to carry three people
on their backs with ease.
Killer Wolves are no such
exalted beings, merely wolves
that have developed a taste
for human flesh. Skilled at
fighting in groups, their
coordinated hunts can easily
devour novice adventurers.
